visual_brief.subject: Pydantic AI warns that streamed requests can exhaust shared model capacity
verified_context: The October 2 Pydantic AI advisory describes model-level streaming concurrency slots remaining occupied after requests end.
The advisory identifies 2.53.0 as patched and distinguishes the unaffected agent-level limiter.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Upgrade affected installations and check which concurrency limiter protects shared streaming endpoints.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A heavy charcoal capacity rack holds a few terracotta blocks in its slots. A detached release linkage rests beside it, explaining retained capacity through a physical mechanical metaphor, without depicting an actual software architecture.
must_show: centered focal elements that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable alternate. Retained blocks and disconnected linkage are readable; architectural scenery competes with the capacity rack.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. The rack and detached release linkage occupy distinct planes, making retained capacity the single focal idea. Empty slots avoid a misleading claim that every slot is always occupied.
candidate_notes.C: Viable alternate. Physical wear and detached linkage fit the story, but the lower angle and fragmented foreground reduce small-crop clarity.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared directly against the DNS sandbox and MCP secrets production images: warm paper, restrained terracotta, substantial charcoal objects and strong spatial depth agree. The mechanical still life uses less landscape and fewer fine technical lines; Golden Reference Fit is 87. It would read as the same publication without company metadata.
